headline: Use of motorcycles, dirt bikes, electric bicycles, ATVs, and mopeds on city streets, sidewalks, and Salem Common.
summary: Safety, enforcement, and ordinance considerations are part of the discussion. Other public property, beyond city streets and sidewalks, is also covered.
items: Operation of motorcycles, dirt bikes, and other motorized vehicles
Use on city streets, sidewalks, and other public property, including Salem Common
Related safety, enforcement, and ordinance considerations
location: City Council Chambers, 93 Washington St., Salem, MA, 2nd Floor

City of Salem, Massachusetts 
Office of the City Clerk 
 
 Maureen Elizabeth Fisher 
City Clerk 
 
 
 
 
 
November 5, 2026 
 
MEETING NOTICE AND AGENDA 
 
The City Council Committee on Public Health, Safety and Environment co-posted with 
the Committee of the Whole will meet in person on Thursday, November 19, 2026, at 
6:00 PM for the purpose of discussing the operation of motorcycles, dirt bikes, electric 
bicycles, electric motorcycles, ATVs, mopeds, and other such motorized vehicles on city 
streets, sidewalks, Salem Common, and other public property, including related safety, 
enforcement, and ordinance considerations. 
This meeting will be held in the City Council Chambers. 93 Washington St., Salem, MA, 
2nd Floor.
